problem.title: Find Row with Maximum 1s
problem.problemStatement: Write a program that finds the row with the maximum number of 1s in a binary matrix where each row is sorted.
problem.input: First line contains rows and cols. Next rows lines contain the matrix.
problem.output: Index of the row with maximum 1s.
